title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain an OS Command Injection vulnerability due to improper neutralization of special elements. This flaw allows a high privileged attacker with remote access to potentially execute arbitrary commands on the affected system. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.2, indicating high severity. No patch or fixed version information is provided in the available data.
